description: Cherohala City Urban Bike The Quintessential Upscale Riding Experience There are the commute rides you have to make, and then there are the ones you want to have. It’s time to look forward to the ride. With Litespeed’s Cherohala City, the urban ride experience just reached its pinnacle. With a frame comprised of 3AL/2.5V titanium that’s been handcrafted in Tennessee using globally sourced premium materials, the commute, the café jaunt, even the weekend workout just got more elegant. More functional. And more fun. The understated and ultra-durable style of the Cherohala City is simply undeniable. The Cherohala City is not only light and stiff thanks to its titanium frame, it’s also tough and resistant to corrosion and the active lifestyle of the daily ride. With rack and fender mounts, as well as fork fender mounts, it’s truly dialed to carry the load. Get your gear to and from work on the commute, grab your weekend groceries or bring lunch with you to the beach; the Cherohala City is all-inclusive service—with style. It also out-performs any alloy competitors. The American-made titanium frame using globally sourced premium materials, paired with a carbon fiber fork provides unmatched vibration damping, keeping the bumps of the streets and gravel paths from fatiguing you. It’s a lively ride experience has to be experienced to be appreciated. And that doesn’t matter what kind of ride it is. With a straight handlebar for total control, an upright, relaxed geometry and quick handling capabilities on comfy 35mm tires, the Cherohala City can as easily maneuver through the hustle of the city streets as it can carve with speed through gravel city bike paths. Make the commute from home to office, hit the café with friends, head out on the weekend for a ride around on the bay, or cruise the beach path in total comfort with true performance and head-turning style. With the Cherohala City, you’re the center of cycling at its finest. This bike is for you if… You value quality as much as functionality. The Cherohala City not only takes you everywhere you want to go, it does so on a frame platform that’s truly second to none, with light weight performance, crisp handling, all with the organic durability and unmatched comfort that titanium delivers. Whether it’s your daily driver or a machine kept at a vacation spot for weekend escapes, the Cherohala City is your ticket to the finest possible urban riding experience.
